create_positive_map: create a positive map tensor linking bounding boxes to token positions from tokenized captions
convert_coco_polys_to_mask: convert COCO annotation polygons to bounding boxes, labels, and token positive maps for MDETR
compose_transforms: compose a pipeline of image and target transforms like crop, resize, flip, and normalize
apply_mdetr_transform: apply MDETR training or inference image transforms and tokenize caption text for detection
random_select_transforms: randomly select between two transform pipelines with configurable probability for data augmentation
